response.sql: WITH country_tallies AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.birth_country), country_stats AS (SELECT tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share, AVG(tally) OVER () AS average_tally FROM country_tallies) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(tally - average_tally) AS average_amount_above_average FROM country_stats WHERE tally > average_tally

assumptions.assumption: Each player_college row counts as one attendance entry; a missing birth_country is excluded because it is not a country.

alternatives.interpretation: Count each player with college attendance once per birth country, regardless of how many attendance rows they have.
alternatives.sql: WITH country_tallies AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS tally FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.birth_country), country_stats AS (SELECT tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share, AVG(tally) OVER () AS average_tally FROM country_tallies) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(tally - average_tally) AS average_amount_above_average FROM country_stats WHERE tally > average_tally
